semantic_assessment.arbitrary_payload: No payload cell is loaded, copied, cast or interpreted by the effects functions. Floating values, pointer elements and padding cannot be inferred from Integer surrogates. Header-transfer conclusions therefore establish no element-level vector validity or C++ ABI semantics.
semantic_assessment.move_frame: Only destination/source receiver cells are updated; all issued object metadata is preserved. Contents and initializedness are preserved for every other issued identity. Entire written receiver footprints are excluded, so this fragment makes no receiver-padding or complete original assigns claim.
semantic_assessment.move_headers: Distinct destination and source allow destination snapshot stores to preserve the source reads, followed by exact source-null/zero stores. Existing source world and header/registry agreement force the explicit source backing to equal the registry backing. The proposed destination/source header and moved-phase world conclusions are consistent with those conditions.
semantic_assessment.registry_world_preservation: Moves transfer the exclusive backing into an already reserved distinct empty destination and leave source empty; swaps exchange bindings or keep the self registry unchanged. All unrelated owners retain headers/backings, and no buffer is freed or written by these header operations. The conditional freeability/exclusivity/frontier invariants are consistent with the new heaps and phases.
semantic_assessment.reserved_phase: Reserved means an active receiver with no registry backing and ready=false plus writable/aligned header storage. It does not assume destination physical field contents or initialized values. Fresh source construction/placement is explicitly a separate pending derivation.
semantic_assessment.swap_headers: Heap.next is fresh relative to all incoming live/issued receiver/backing identities; automatic_available supplies physical placement/alignment/separation for the24-byte temporary. The exact three header snapshots exchange both headers. The self case restores the same header observation while still creating/ending a temporary; it does not widen the original separated C contract.
semantic_assessment.swap_lifetime_and_frame: The temporary is issued and dead after actual Heap.end_automatic; original issued metadata and contents/initializedness outside written receivers remain preserved. Heap.next advances, so no full heap equality or source history erasure is claimed. The temporary is not a registry owner and registry retire is never substituted for Heap.release.
semantic_assessment.world: All active receivers have valid storage. Ready receivers have initialized pointer/size/capacity headers matching registry bindings. The registry is valid at Heap.next, prohibits active receiver/backing overlap and shared positive backing, and every positive active backing is live/freeable. This is a conditional relation; it does not establish registration, complete source ownership, payload extent/initializedness or arbitrary incoming source eligibility.
